query:
select item.id as "id!"
          from unnest($2::uuid[]) as item(id)
         where (select count(*)
                  from (select 1
                          from entity_links link
                         where link.tenant_id = $1 and link.source_item_id = item.id
                        union all
                        select 1
                          from entity_links link
                         where link.tenant_id = $1 and link.target_item_id = item.id
                         limit $3) touching) >= $3
         order by item.id
         limit 1
